bear_assumptions: Eight times approximately USD 5.38 guided non-GAAP EPS if margin contraction persists and branded checkout, transaction-margin growth or active accounts weaken.
base_assumptions: Twelve times approximately USD 5.38 guided non-GAAP EPS if raised guidance is delivered but durable margin and active-account acceleration remain unproven.
bull_assumptions: Fifteen times approximately USD 5.38 guided non-GAAP EPS if branded checkout stabilizes, Venmo monetization improves, and transaction-margin and operating-margin growth recover.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if current primary evidence and a fresh mark restore compelling confidence-adjusted expected return, base upside, payoff asymmetry and margin of safety; downgrade on renewed branded-checkout deterioration, persistent margin contraction, active-account losses, weaker free cash flow, regulatory or credit deterioration, or guidance reduction.
